    About this Item

    • 📱 0.66-Inch Display – Enjoy bright and clear visuals with perfect for calls and basic entertainment
    • 🔋 800mAh Battery – Get up to 3-4 hours of talk time and 2 days of standby, keeping you connected longer
    • 🎵 All-in-One Entertainment – Built-in Music Player and Bluetooth for non-stop fun and connectivity
    • 📦 Dual SIM + Expandable Storage – Manage personal & professional contacts easily with dual SIM slots and expand memory up to 8GB
    • 🛡️ Durable & User-Friendly Design – Strong polycarbonate body, enlarged keypad buttons, and IKALL’s 1-year warranty with 2000+ service centers across India

    Product description

    The IKALL K32 Mobile is a compact and reliable keypad phone designed for everyday use. It features a 0.66-inch clear display with 720p resolution, 24MB RAM, 32MB storage (expandable up to 8GB), and dual SIM support for easy connectivity. Enjoy music and Bluetooth in one lightweight device. Powered by a 800mAh battery, it provides up to 3-4 hours of talk time and 2 days of standby. Its sturdy polycarbonate body with enlarged keypad buttons ensures durability and user-friendly operation. Backed by IKALL’s trusted brand value since 2011 and 2000+ service centers across India, the K32comes with a 1-year handset warranty and 6 months on accessories, making it the perfect blend of simplicity, functionality, and style.
